### Independence Realty Trust Stockholders and Centerspace Shareholders Approve Merger


November 10, 2026


PHILADELPHIA & MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: IRT) (“IRT”), a multifamily real estate investment trust (“REIT”) included in the S&P MidCap 400 Index, and Centerspace (NYSE: CSR) (“Centerspace”), a multifamily REIT, today announced that, at their respective special meetings held today, IRT stockholders and Centerspace shareholders approved all of the proposals necessary for the closing of the previously announced merger pursuant to which Centerspace will merge with IRT (the “Merger”).


“We greatly appreciate the support of IRT stockholders, who voted overwhelmingly in favor of the merger. Today’s vote is an exciting milestone toward creating a leading multifamily REIT focused on high-growth, non-gateway markets in the Sunbelt, Midwest, and Mountain West regions of the U.S.,” said Scott Schaeffer, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of IRT. He continued, “We are bringing together portfolios in markets that have historically delivered above-average NOI growth with lower volatility.”


Approximately 88.1% of the votes cast at IRT’s special meeting were voted in favor of the issuance of IRT common stock in connection with the Merger. Approximately 99.6% of the votes cast at Centerspace’s special meeting, representing 80.4% of Centerspace’s outstanding common shares, were voted in favor of the Merger. Final voting results are subject to certification by the companies' respective independent inspectors of election and will be filed by both companies with the SEC in separate Current Reports on Form 8-K.


The completion of the Merger is subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the remaining closing conditions. In addition, IRT has the right, in its sole discretion and by written notice to Centerspace, to defer the closing until the earliest of (i) the tenth business day after, with respect to each designated mortgage loan of Centerspace’s subsidiaries that has not been repaid, refinanced or defeased in accordance with the merger agreement, the applicable lender has granted the required lender consent to the transactions contemplated by the merger agreement or has indicated that it is ready, willing and able to grant that consent subject only to the closing and satisfaction of conditions thereto that by their nature are to be satisfied at the closing and all other conditions to the effectiveness of that consent have been satisfied or waived, and (ii) the tenth business day before June 30, 2027.


Upon the closing, Centerspace shareholders will receive 3.800 shares of IRT common stock for each Centerspace common share owned, and holders of common units in Centerspace’s operating partnership will receive 3.800 common units in IRT’s operating partnership for each unit held, subject to certain adjustments, with cash paid in lieu of fractional shares.


**About Independence Realty Trust, Inc.**


Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: IRT), an S&P MidCap 400 Company, is a REIT that owns and operates multifamily communities across non-gateway U.S. markets. IRT’s investment strategy is focused on gaining scale near major employment centers within key amenity rich submarkets that offer good school districts and high-quality retail. IRT’s main investment objective is to provide attractive risk-adjusted returns to shareholders through diligent portfolio management, strong operational performance, and a consistent return on capital through distributions and capital appreciation. More information may be found on IRT’s website,[www.irtliving.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.irtliving.com&esheet=54639052&newsitemid=20261110836089&lan=en-US&anchor=www.irtliving.com&index=1&md5=85371e5958e33e50c1f276dfbf3c8ca8) .


**About Centerspace**


Centerspace (NYSE: CSR) is an owner and operator of apartment communities committed to providing great homes by focusing on integrity and serving others. Founded in 1970, as of September 9, 2026, Centerspace owned 47 apartment communities consisting of 10,456 units located in Colorado, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, and Utah. Centerspace was named a Top Workplace in 2026 by USA Today and for the seventh consecutive year in 2026 by the Minnesota Star Tribune. For more information, please visit[www.centerspacehomes.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centerspacehomes.com&esheet=54639052&newsitemid=20261110836089&lan=en-US&anchor=www.centerspacehomes.com&index=2&md5=fb9b2f4c3860cea1e6eac67b434705e6) .
